verdict.rationale: The only documented programmatic channel is EFILE/ReFILE. Through it, certified tax software and enrolled electronic filers can transmit current and prior-year T1 returns and amendments system-to-system. The much broader online-portal feature set has no evidence of any API equivalent: business registration, submitting documents, enquiries, payments, direct deposit, notices and authorizations. EFILE is also gated behind software certification and filer enrollment, and the probe found no llms.txt or agent-oriented docs index. Missing for 10: a public API covering business registration, payments, document submission, enquiries and account management; open developer docs; agent-oriented docs; parity beyond T1 return filing.
